description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LocationAPI component of the OrangeHRM administrative API. It contains test cases for various LocationAPI methods such as getOne, getAll, create, update, and delete, along with validation rule tests. The tests utilize fixture data, mock services, and verify API interactions within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LocationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LocationAPI endpoints and validation logic within the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates the LocationAPI object, populates fixture data, and mocks external services.

methods.name: getTestCasesByKey
methods.description: Retrieves specific test case data from fixture files based on the given key.

methods.name: testGettersAndSetters
methods.description: Tests the getter and setter methods of the LocationAPI class for service dependencies.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single location by ID via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies the validation rules for the getOne API method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all locations with optional filters.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the getAll API method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new location via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the create API method.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the update API method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a location, verifying pre- and post-deletion counts and returned IDs.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the delete API method.
